Description: An X-Ray latency estate: a Fargate publisher whose dependency latency is driven by an SSM flag and which traces every frame to X-Ray (an internal-pipeline and a downstream-call subsegment), a second flag that suppresses the dependency metric, the p90 end-to-end latency alarm over it, and the backfill Lambda.

Token.Description: minted prefix for every physical name

TraceServiceName.Description: minted X-Ray service name of the root segment

Properties.Description: Controls simulated dependency latency mode for the motion detection task
Controls whether dependency latency metrics are published

ContainerDefinitions.Name: HLSProcess
Command:
set -u
# Flint motion-detection stand-in: one frame per loop. Reads the two flags from SSM on every frame,
# publishes the per-component Time metrics and, when enabled, the dependency latency, then traces the
# frame to X-Ray: a root segment spanning the frame, an InternalPipeline subsegment and a QuartzAPI
# subsegment for the downstream ReportPerson call. The end-to-end lag is internal time plus the call.
dim() { printf '[{"Name":"Camera_name","Value":"ALL"},{"Name":"Operation","Value":"%s"}]' "$1"; }
datum() { printf '{"MetricName":"%s","Dimensions":%s,"Value":%s,"Unit":"%s","Timestamp":"%s","StorageResolution":1}' "$1" "$(dim "$2")" "$3" "$4" "$TS"; }
hexid() { od -An -N"$1" -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n'; }
secs() { printf '%d.%03d' $(($1 / 1000)) $(($1 % 1000)); }
echo "Starting Flint Motion Detection Service stage=$STAGE cluster=$CLUSTER_NAME"
while true; do
  MODE=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "$QUARTZ_LATENCY_MODE_PARAM" --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null) || MODE=degraded
  PUB=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "$PUBLISH_DEP_METRICS_PARAM" --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null) || PUB=true
  PF=$((450 + RANDOM % 500)); HLS=$((1000 + RANDOM % 70)); CPU=$((47 + RANDOM % 3))
  if [ "$MODE" = degraded ]; then Q=$((18000 + RANDOM % 2000)); else Q=$((2000 + RANDOM % 2500)); fi
  INT="$((PF + HLS + 1)).6"; FQL="$((PF + HLS + 1 + Q)).6"
  # One timestamp per frame, shared by both namespaces, so a frame's three series land in one bucket.
  TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  aws cloudwatch put-metric-data --namespace "$FLINT_NAMESPACE" --metric-data "[$(datum Time ProcessFrame $PF Milliseconds),$(datum Time MotionDetection 1.6 Milliseconds),$(datum Time HLSStartLag $HLS Milliseconds),$(datum Time InternalPipelineTime $INT Milliseconds),$(datum Time FrameQuartzLag $FQL Milliseconds),$(datum NonIdlePct CPU $CPU Percent)]" || echo "put-metric-data failed"
  if [ "$PUB" = true ]; then
    aws cloudwatch put-metric-data --namespace "$DEPENDENCY_NAMESPACE" --metric-data "[{\"MetricName\":\"APILatency\",\"Dimensions\":[{\"Name\":\"Service\",\"Value\":\"Quartz\"},{\"Name\":\"Operation\",\"Value\":\"ReportPerson\"}],\"Value\":$Q,\"Unit\":\"Milliseconds\",\"Timestamp\":\"$TS\",\"StorageResolution\":1}]" || echo "dependency put failed"
  fi
  # The frame's trace, back-dated so it ENDS now: [START, MID) internal, [MID, END] the dependency call.
  END=$(date +%s%3N); IMS=$((PF + HLS + 2)); START=$((END - IMS - Q)); MID=$((START + IMS))
  TID="1-$(printf %08x $((START / 1000)))-$(hexid 12)"
  DOC="{\"name\":\"$TRACE_SERVICE\",\"id\":\"$(hexid 8)\",\"trace_id\":\"$TID\",\"start_time\":$(secs $START),\"end_time\":$(secs $END),\"subsegments\":[{\"name\":\"InternalPipeline\",\"id\":\"$(hexid 8)\",\"start_time\":$(secs $START),\"end_time\":$(secs $MID),\"metadata\":{\"operations\":{\"ProcessFrame\":\"${PF}ms\",\"MotionDetection\":\"1.6ms\",\"HLSStartLag\":\"${HLS}ms\"}}},{\"name\":\"QuartzAPI\",\"id\":\"$(hexid 8)\",\"start_time\":$(secs $MID),\"end_time\":$(secs $END),\"http\":{\"request\":{\"method\":\"POST\",\"url\":\"https://quartz-api.example/v1/report-person\"},\"response\":{\"status\":200}},\"metadata\":{\"service\":\"Quartz\",\"operation\":\"ReportPerson\",\"latency_ms\":$Q}}]}"
  aws xray put-trace-segments --trace-segment-documents "$DOC" --query UnprocessedTraceSegments --output text || echo "put-trace-segments failed"
  echo "quartz_api_call: operation=ReportPerson latency=${Q}ms mode=$MODE publish=$PUB trace=$TID status=200"
  sleep 1
done

Properties.GroupDescription: sim2real Flint motion detection Fargate tasks

Code.ZipFile:
import json
import logging
import time

logger = logging.getLogger()
logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)


def lambda_handler(event, context):
    logger.info(f"lambda_handler -- event: {json.dumps(event)}")
    start_time = int(time.time())
    time.sleep(5)
    end_time = int(time.time())
    logger.info(f"start: {start_time}, end: {end_time}, duration: {end_time - start_time}")
    return {"statusCode": 200,
            "body": json.dumps({"message": "DLQ check completed", "messagesProcessed": 0,
                                "duration": end_time - start_time})}

Properties.AlarmDescription: P90 time, in milliseconds, from initial frame processing to reporting an object to the dependency
